rows.text: completes the acquisition of a **60% stake in R&D platform Prathyak Laboratories (Genome Valley, Hyderabad) for Rs 15 crore**, funded from unutilised IPO proceeds, replacing its planned greenfield research centre; the remaining 40% carries a right of first refusal at the same valuation.

rows.quant: Rs 204.00 cr projected over 3 years; ~8.7% of mcap
rows.text: its subsidiary Noumed Pharmaceuticals renews a three-year OTC medicines supply agreement with an unnamed Australian pharmacy chain at a projected **AUD 30 million, about Rs 204 crore on the filing's own rate**
